paragraphs: Apple is preparing to bring back its Product(RED) partnership with special-edition versions of the HomePod mini 2 and AirPods Max 2, according to an unconfirmed report.
The products will supposedly arrive around Dec. 1, coinciding with World AIDS Day and the 20th anniversary of the (RED) organization.

Apple has a long history with Product(RED), a partnership in which the company donates a portion of proceeds from specially branded products to support the fight against AIDS. The collaboration previously produced red versions of the iPhone and iPod, along with various accessories.
But then Apple moved away from the program. The company discontinued its red iPhones without replacing them and gradually phased out the last remaining Product(RED) accessories.

The return of red hardware would give Apple a high-profile way to revive the partnership just in time for the holiday shopping season. The timing also coincides with the 20th anniversary of (RED), which works with companies to raise money for the Global Fund to fight AIDS.
The new color options will arrive shortly after Apple introduced the latest versions of both products, according to a report published on Monday by Bloomberg.
The HomePod mini 2 launched just a few weeks ago for $149. It comes in a range of colors, but red isn’t one of them. That will apparently change soon.
Meanwhile, the $549 AirPods Max 2 arrived in March. But don’t expect them to be bright red.
